title: Lost, Found, and Full of Heart: "Junior Rabbit Travels to Pennsylvania" is a Journey Young Readers Won't Forget
text:
Lost, Found, and Full of Heart: “Junior Rabbit Travels to Pennsylvania” is a Journey Young Readers Won’t Forget By: AB Newswire April 23, 2025 at 17:30 PM EDT A tale of courage, curiosity, and unexpected friendship—now available on Amazon ATLANTA, GA - What happens when a young rabbit finds himself far from home, alone in a big unfamiliar place? Junior Rabbit Travels to Pennsylvania , written by Jenny White and illustrated by Danny Koko, is a charming and uplifting children’s book that takes young readers on a thoughtful adventure about finding your way—even when you feel lost.
Now available on Amazon , this delightful story follows Junior Rabbit as he accidentally winds up inside a mysterious building in Pennsylvania. With no idea how he got there—or how to get back—Junior hops through confusion, fear, and discovery until a gentle voice breaks through the silence: “Pssst, Junior, over here!”
What unfolds next is more than a journey through hallways and revolving doors. It’s a story about trusting your instincts, listening closely, and realizing that even in the most unfamiliar places, you’re never truly alone.
White’s storytelling is simple, sincere, and emotionally grounded—making it a perfect read-aloud for classrooms, libraries, or bedtime. Koko’s illustrations bring warmth and whimsy to Junior’s world, capturing the wonder of a rabbit’s-eye-view of the unknown.
Why This Book Belongs in Every Young Reader’s Hands:
Addresses real feelings of anxiety and uncertainty in a safe, age-appropriate way
Encourages problem-solving, courage, and the importance of listening
Perfect for ages 4–8 , especially readers just beginning to explore stories independently
A great conversation starter about navigating new places and situations
Whether your child is heading off to school, traveling for the first time, or simply learning about the world beyond their front yard, Junior Rabbit Travels to Pennsylvania offers an endearing reminder that even the smallest hops forward lead to something beautiful.
About the Author
Jenny White is a passionate storyteller and children’s advocate who brings empathy and imagination to everything she writes. When she’s not crafting heartfelt tales, she volunteers with the Ronald McDonald House Charities and the Capuchin Mission, and hosts her own podcast, Let’s Talk About It with Jenny White, every Friday at 8 p.m. EST. She can be heard on Stitcher or at www.blogtalkradio.com/pjcmedia ​.
About Author’s Tranquility Press
Author’s Tranquility Press is a full-service publishing and marketing agency based in Atlanta, Georgia. Known for uplifting bold, purposeful voices, ATP helps authors reach audiences around the world with stories that matter—whether they educate, entertain, or inspire.
